headline: 6 Solana program/key addresses catalogued from Meteora docs and GitHub; 0 multisigs or upgrade authorities found, and no on-chain reads were possible.

findings.text: Solana explorer name-tag search was not completed. A direct fetch of solscan.io for the DAMM v1 program was rejected by the fetch allowlist, and no further explorer or search-grounded queries were available this run. No explorer-sourced addresses were recorded.

No standalone 'deployed contracts' page was found. The Meteora docs DAMM v1 Program Accounts page lists the DAMM v1 PROGRAM_ID, a STAGING_PROGRAM_ID, and the Dynamic Vault program, affiliate program, vault base key and treasury addresses. The Implementation and Limits page restates the mainnet program ID. A DAMM v1 'Pool Fee Configs' page with published config keys is listed in llms.txt but was not opened.

The docs audit index for DAMM v1 lists Offside Labs reports (0.5.1, 0.5.2, 0.5.3, 0.5.4, 0.5.7), Halborn (July 2022) and Oak (October 2022), hosted in the MeteoraAg/audits GitHub repo. The PDFs were not opened, so no in-scope address tables were extracted.

The MeteoraAg/damm-v1-sdk repo README states the program ID. No Foundry/hardhat-style deployment artifacts exist for Solana programs. The repo tree was not walked at a pinned SHA, so no commit is recorded.
Only one chain (Solana) is in scope. Zero addresses surfaced from block explorers. Six addresses surfaced from docs and the GitHub README; see admin_addresses.

DAMM v1 pools are PDAs derived from sorted mints and curve type (or a config), not enumerated by an EVM-style factory view. The DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana, so no children were enumerated. The docs mention a Data API at https://damm-api.meteora.ag, which was not queried.

Roles were assigned tentatively from docs text. The program IDs are 'other', the Dynamic Vault program is 'vault', and the fee-vault owner is 'treasury'. No bytecode or upgrade authority was read, so actor_class is 'unknown' for all entries.
Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched docs page. Addresses seen only in search snippets (DLMM, DBC, DAMM v2, M3M3 programs) are listed in unknowns, not admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked the Meteora docs, llms.txt index, audit index and damm-v1-sdk README. Catalogued 6 Solana addresses (programs, vault base key, treasury). No explorer, upgrade-authority or multisig data was reachable this run.

evidence.shows: The protocol website probe returned only page metadata (title 'Home | Meteora', description about stable assets dynamic vaults and a Solana yield layer). No addresses are present in the fetched body.

The Constants table lists PROGRAM_ID Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB ('Deployed DAMM v1 program') and STAGING_PROGRAM_ID ammbh4CQztZ6txJ8AaQgPsWjd6o7GhmvopS2JAo5bCB (staging feature build). It also describes the Operator account (admin-created permission account), pool PDA derivations, and the pool's Dynamic Vault relationships (a_vault/b_vault).

The page states the DAMM v1 mainnet program is Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB. It also notes that a configured fee-update authority can only decrease trade fees, and that an admin path can set fees and partner settings.

The README states Program ID Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB. The repo has programs/, ts-client/, rust-client/ and dynamic-amm-quote/ directories. Fetched from the main branch; no commit SHA was pinned.

The Constants table lists the Dynamic Vault PROGRAM_ID 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi, AFFILIATE_PROGRAM_ID GacY9YuN16HNRTy7ZWwULPccwvfFSBeNLuAQP7y38Du3, VAULT_BASE_KEY HWzXGcGHy4tcpYfaRDCyLNzXqBTv3E6BttpCH2vJxArv, and Treasury 9kZeN47U2dubGbbzMrzzoRAUvpuxVLRcjW9XiFpYjUo4 (required owner of fee_vault and reward destination accounts). The Vault account has admin and operator fields, but their values are not given. This is a derived link: DAMM v1 pools hold reserves in Dynamic Vaults, per the DAMM v1 accounts page.

The docs index lists the DAMM v1 pages (Pool Fee Configs, Program Accounts, Instructions, audits at /resources/audits/damm-v1.md, bug bounty at /resources/bug-bounty/overview.md). It also lists the Dynamic Vault and Stake2Earn docs, and the DAMM v1 Data API reference.

The audit index lists Offside Labs reports (0.5.1, 0.5.2, 0.5.3, 0.5.4, 0.5.7), a Halborn report (July 2022) and an Oak report (October 2022), linked to PDFs in github.com/MeteoraAg/audits under damm-v1/.

protocol_metadata.about: DAMM v1 is Meteora's legacy dynamic AMM on Solana: liquidity providers deposit two-token pairs into constant-product or stable-swap pools and receive LP tokens. Pool reserves are held in Meteora Dynamic Vaults, which route idle liquidity to lending strategies for extra yield. The program also supports LST depeg-aware stable pools, LP liquidity locks, and farms.
